notes.title: 【Development Progress】Curry Princess GOLD Report [August]
notes.content: [h2]🎮 Progress Report \[August Edition][/h2][p]Hello, this is Saori UTSUMI from Birdkin Studio, currently developing [i]Curry Princess GOLD[/i]. Thank you as always for your support.[/p][p][/p][p]Here is the progress report for August.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎯 Goals and Progress[/h3][p]The goal for August was:[/p][list][*][p]To [b]fully complete four stages (including effects and fine details)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The achievement rate was about 90%.[/p][p]Some tasks could not be finished as planned, but overall, the stages have taken shape.[/p][p][/p][p]The goals for September are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Begin development of the new Stage 5[/p][/*][*][p]Continue working on the remaining tasks step by step[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎯 Upcoming Event Exhibitions[/h3][p]Unfortunately, we were not selected for the Osaka Indie Games Summit.[/p][p]At this time, there are no scheduled exhibition events.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎯 About Screenshots and Other Materials[/h3][p]This time, we won’t be sharing screenshots or story-related details.[/p][p]The reason is that most of the current work would involve spoilers.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌊 A Final Word[/h2][p]In August, I was able to take about a week of proper rest, while still making steady progress on development. Little by little, the whole game is coming together, and I can feel it taking shape in a very positive way. I will continue developing the game carefully and with enjoyment. I would be grateful if you continue to watch over the project.[/p]

notes.title: Development Update – June 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is [b]Saori UTSUMI[/b], the all-rounder at Birdkin Studio, currently working on [b]Curry Princess GOLD[/b].
It's already June—time flies! Here's a quick update on our development progress:

---

🎮[b] Current Progress[/b]

- **Story Mode**: The four new stages created last month are now in the tuning and balancing phase.
- **How to Play Guide**: Content is about 90% complete, localization is at 40%, and image assets are at 10%.

Throughout May, we focused on debugging the event demo build and working on new stage designs.

---

🛠 [b]How We Build a Stage[/b]

Here’s a general flow of how we create a new stage:

1. Start with a rough sketch and idea for the stage structure
2. Design the background and enemy visuals
3. Implement them into the stage
4. Estimate what animations and sound effects are needed
5. Create sound effects (realistic ones are handled by Hideaki)
6. Draw animations
7. Adjust enemy scripts
8. Break down enemy AI logic into tasks
9. Implement enemy behavior and attacks

Each stage also includes an intro scene and a clear scene, which we build as we go.

By the way, I'm personally handling all of the implementation work! Hideaki helps out with the sound effects I’m not so good at—especially the realistic ones—and that’s been a huge help.

---

That's it for now!

Thanks for following our development. We’re working hard to bring **Curry Princess GOLD** to life, so please stay tuned and keep supporting us!

notes.title: Work In Progress [5/1/2025]
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm Saori UTSUMI, the all-rounder at Birdkin Studio, currently developing *Curry Princess GOLD*.

Now that May is here, we’ve got about seven months left in 2025. Will we really finish it in time?! Let’s take a look at where we’re at right now:

**Current Progress:**

- Classic Mode: 95% complete
- Story Mode System: 90% complete, 2/X stages playable
- 2P Mode System: 70% complete, 2/X stages playable
- Leaderboards (Nintendo Switch version): 90%
- Save System (Nintendo Switch version): 95%
- Leaderboards (Steam PC version): 5%
- Save System (Steam PC version): 1%
- External features like catalogs and achievement systems: 10%
- Input device support & key/button rebinding: 40%
- Localization (English): 75%

By the way—have you had a chance to watch the video featured on this Steam store page?

I’ve released it as a sort of progress report to give you a clear idea of what the game *actually* looks and plays like at this point.

To be honest, it’s probably not ideal as a promotional video—but I’ve chosen not to release a demo version, so I wanted the video alone to convey a concrete impression of the gameplay.

After all, if you buy the game and it turns out to be totally different from what you imagined, you might end up returning it or just abandoning it—and that would be disappointing for both of us, right?

Also, at the events we’ve attended, many people asked for a versus mode—so we’ve added a 2P Versus Mode! To show how that’s coming along, we’ve uploaded a second video. It’s still a rough version for now, but we’re working hard to make it even more fun by the final release. Stay tuned!

notes.title: TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025
notes.content:
We totally forgot to share this here, but on March 8-9, Curry Princess GOLD had its first playable demo at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45363342/sale/TOKYOINDIEGAMESSUMMIT]TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025[/url] in Kichijoji, Tokyo!

Sorry for the late report, but we just wanted to say a huge THANK YOU to everyone who stopped by and played the game! We made 50 special can badges, and they were all gone by the end—so we think over 100 people gave it a try!

We'll be sharing more updates here from time to time, so stay tuned and thanks for your support! 😊✨
